```yaml
name: Update Nix Vendor Hash

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'go.mod'
      - 'go.sum'
      - 'flake.nix'
      - 'flake.lock'
      - '.github/workflows/update-nix-vendorhash.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      create_pr:
        description: 'Create a PR with the updated vendor hash'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true
      branch_name:
        description: 'Branch name for the PR (if create_pr is true)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: 'chore/update-nix-vendorhash'

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  update-vendorhash:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Nix
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v31
        with:
          extra_nix_config: |
            access-tokens = github.com=${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Check if vendor hash needs update
        id: check
        run: |
          # Run the helper script to check and update the vendor hash
          # The script should exit 0 if no changes, 1 if changes made
          chmod +x scripts/update-vendorhash.sh
          if ./scripts/update-vendorhash.sh; then
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Configure Git
        if: steps.check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update nix vendor hash"
          title: "chore: update nix vendor hash"
          body: |
            This PR updates the Nix vendor hash to match the current Go dependencies.
            
            Auto-generated by the `update-nix-vendorhash` workflow.
          branch: ${{ inputs.branch_name || 'chore/update-nix-vendorhash' }}
          delete-branch: true
          base: ${{ github.head_ref || 'main' }}
```
